arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-close.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo "PREFLIGHT_OS=$(uname -s)"
echo "PREFLIGHT_USER=$(id -un)"
echo "PREFLIGHT_REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
echo "PREFLIGHT_MAIN_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c7996a41c22d99f52f25d4c12e793bb3b3a8917d
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths=[p for p in Path('.').rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
print('TOTAL_FILES',len(paths))
for p in paths:
 s=str(p)
 if (re.search(r'(?i)(supervisor|telegram|codex|coordina|cloud|smoke|e2e|auth|notification|gate|doctor|control)',s) and (s.endswith(('.py','.md','.yml','.yaml','.toml','.json','.sh'))) and len(s)<125):
  print('RELEVANT',s)
PY
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "CODEX_CLI=$(command -v codex)"; codex --version; else echo "CODEX_CLI_NOT_INSTALLED_ON_REA_HOST"; fi
echo "PREFLIGHT_READY"
